# מסדירים (Masdirim): all 447 sedarim of the Tanakh

> The traditional Jewish division of the Hebrew Bible into sedarim, with where each seder starts and ends in the chapter:verse numbering (given only to help locate the text). Source: https://www.masdirim.org (credit: "החלוקה לסדרים: מסדירים, www.masdirim.org"). Each line links to the seder's page with the full text. More: https://www.masdirim.org/llms.txt
